# espalier_image (Data Source)

An image already present in the container runtime, e.g. one built or pulled outside Terraform. Fails if the image is not present; use the `espalier_image` resource to pull it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An image built with `container build -t app:dev .`
data "espalier_image" "app" {
  name = "app:dev"
}

output "app_digest" {
  value = data.espalier_image.app.digest
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Image reference, resolved like the `espalier_image` resource's `name`.

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) Digest of the image index or manifest.
- `id` (String) Fully qualified reference the runtime stores the image under.
- `platforms` (List of String) Platforms of the image (`os/arch[/variant]`).
